chunks.title: LEQ — Long Essay Question (6 points) — Q3 Set 2: Scientific Revolution vs. the Enlightenment
chunks.content: AP European History LEQ, 6 points, standardized rubric. A Thesis/Claim [1]. B Contextualization [1]. C Evidence [0–2]: two specific pieces (1), used to support the argument (1). D Analysis and Reasoning [0–2]: reasoning process (comparison) (1), complex understanding (1). Q3 Set 2 prompt: compare the Scientific Revolution and the Enlightenment. Common failure: missing contextualization; reasoning without complexity.

chunks.title: LEQ Q3 Set 2 exemplar — Sample 3B, 4/6
chunks.content: Q3 (Set 2) scored 4/6 (Thesis 1, Context 0, Evidence 2, Analysis 1). Earned the thesis, both Evidence points, and one Analysis point (comparison reasoning). Lost Contextualization (too brief/absent) and the Complexity point. Illustrates a common 4-point profile: good thesis and evidence but weak context and no complexity.
